verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal's official docs explicitly describe an offline mode: payments are stored locally on the POS device or smart reader when internet connectivity drops, and automatically forwarded to Stripe once the connection is restored — directly matching the story. This is documented consistently across multiple doc pages, indicating it's a core, supported feature rather than an edge case. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on merchant reports confirming real-world reliability of offline storage/forwarding (e.g., limits on transaction volume/time offline, failure edge cases).
